subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & retention requirements (Redwood + Acme)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & retention requirements (Redwood + Acme)

Hi Sam — great to meet you and Priya on the call earlier. Thanks for walking through Acme's requirements. Below is a short recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment. Please correct anything I missed.

Summary of pain / goals (from call):
- Need SOC 2 Type II evidence and supporting artifacts for procurement review.
- Audit-log retention and exportability for 7+ years for specific regulated product lines.
- DPA & data residency controls (customer-managed KMS for encryption) are required.
- Pen test evidence and remediation notes needed for security assessment.

Redwood capabilities called out:
- We have a current SOC 2 Type II report (summary attached) and an evidence bundle we can share with an NDA.
- Audit logs: configurable retention policies; exports available via S3 export or CSV/JSON export endpoints.
- DPA: we have a standard DPA and can provide a redline-friendly doc (attached).
- Pen tests: we run annual third-party pentests; we can provide redacted reports and remediation timelines.

Action items / next steps (proposed):
1) I'll share our SOC 2 summary and a stub of supporting evidence today (attached).
2) Please share the name and email of your security reviewer and any specific evidence they need (e.g., control IDs or sample logs).
3) Rishi (CC'd) to set up a 30-min follow-up with Acme security to walk through logs export and KMS options next week.
4) Priya: if you can confirm retention window and whether export automation is required, we can scope the implementation effort.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, dpa-template-Redwood_v1.docx, pen-test-evidence-stub.txt

Thanks — happy to adjust based on your team's needs.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & retention requirements (Redwood + Acme)

Thanks, Marissa — this is very helpful and summarized well. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Our security reviewer is Priya Shah (cc'd). She will want to see control mapping to the SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (especially around access controls and change management).
- Retention: we need immutable audit-log retention for 7 years for product X; periodic automated exports delivered to our S3 bucket would be ideal.
- KMS: customer-managed KMS is a hard requirement for the data-at-rest scope we plan to onboard.
- Pen tests: we can accept redacted reports; we typically ask for scope, findings, and remediation timeline.

Can you confirm whether Redwood's audit log export supports automated delivery to an external S3 target and whether key rotation is compatible with our KMS setup? Also please send the SOC 2 evidence package under an NDA — I'll have Priya confirm what extra control artifacts she needs.

Sam
Director, Security Operations
Acme Corp
sam.torres@acme.com

Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & retention requirements (Redwood + Acme)

Thanks Sam — answers inline below and next steps: 

- S3 export: Yes. Redwood supports automated export of audit logs to a customer-provided S3 bucket. We support prefix-based partitioning and can deliver daily or weekly batches. We'll include an example manifest and config in the export docs.
- KMS: We support customer-managed KMS in our Private offering (and for Dedicated customers). Key rotation is managed by the customer's KMS; Redwood integrates with AWS KMS and GCP KMS for envelope encryption. We'll note any required config steps for onboarding.
- SOC 2 evidence: Attached is the SOC 2 summary and a stubbed evidence index. We will share the full evidence bundle under an NDA.
- Pen test evidence: Attached is a redacted third-party report (stub) and our remediation tracker. We can provide additional context during the follow-up review.

Proposed immediate next steps: 
1) I'll send an NDA link (DocuSign) to Sam/Priya by end of day to allow sharing the full evidence bundle.
2) Rishi to schedule a 30-min technical deep dive with Priya next week (logs export + KMS + retention config). Rishi, can you propose 2x 30-min slots (Wed/Thu preferred)?
3) Priya: please send any specific control IDs or artifacts you want mapped (e.g., CC4, AC-2 equivalent) and we will prepare a control mapping doc.
4) Legal: once Priya confirms DPA redline items, we can exchange redlines. The attached DPA template is our starting point.

If it's helpful, I'll also attach a short implementation checklist showing expected work items and timeline for audit-log export and KMS onboarding.

Thanks — looking forward to the next call.

Best,
Marissa
